## Parent

- #33 — [T32] Certify the Foundation 0.1.0 release candidate
- Governing specification: #1

## What to build

Give operators reproducible evidence that the actual declared Linux runtimes enforce the Hardened Worker isolation, protocol and cleanup contract.

Owned capability coverage: `document.hardened-worker`.

The Native behavior is already substantially implemented at the planning baseline. Reuse verified implementation and existing independent corpora; complete the declared gaps, migration surface and certification instead of rebuilding the feature.

Maintainer scope amendment, 2026-09-08: certify only currently verifiable environments. The required scope is the actual Ubuntu 24.04 / Linux x86-64 environments exercised with JDK 8, 11, 17 and 21; exact vendor/build, image and tool identities must accompany evidence. Windows x86-64 and macOS x86-64/arm64 remain explicitly uncertified and are not release blockers for Foundation 0.1.0. This supersedes the earlier four-OS-platform requirement for this release only; every other #1/#33 contract and non-goal remains in force.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Run the shared public Document Workflow contract in IN_PROCESS and HARDENED_WORKER on the declared Linux/JDK profiles with pinned production artifact and launcher identities.
- [ ] Certify authenticated bounded protocol, command order/query barriers, malformed-frame rejection, enforced termination, restricted temporary roots and denied unauthorized filesystem/network access.
- [ ] Failure, cancellation and crash cases retain safe diagnostics and Publication Receipts and leave no live child or owned temporary data after confirmed termination.
- [ ] State the actual launcher, Security Manager and resource-enforcement prerequisites; unsupported environments report WORKER_UNAVAILABLE and receive no inferred certification or artificial Reference Suite facade.
- [ ] All mandatory evidence for this slice is tied to the actual tested artifacts and declared environment. Retain separate independent syntax, standards, semantic and visual records and negative controls; a missing tool, uncovered required rule or mismatched identity cannot become PASS by changing labels or producer names.
- [ ] Matching public Native and Migration Facade behavior is verified at the highest available seam through Document Workflow outcomes, reopened files, Publication Receipts and safe failures. Avoid backend identity/private-call assertions; test the actual external Provider seam only where applicable.
- [ ] Update the applicable Capability Matrix, Facade Surface, generated/public English contracts, Chinese usage material and clean-room provenance together. Mark only the completed, dependency-satisfied capability or subcapability compatible, and introduce no unsupported Stable stub.
- [ ] Run the smallest relevant validation during development and the repository-mandated full verification before submission; shipped-code/build-compatibility changes also pass the existing JDK matrix. Resolve applicable Standards/Spec review findings against the session's recorded implementation baseline.
- [ ] Keep Java 8 runtime compatibility, explicit resource ownership and clean-room licensing. Acceptance-only tools, fonts and fixtures stay outside product runtime; do not implement downstream Forms, Trust signing, Conformance, SVG/XML, OCR, Sanitization or Office tickets.

## Blocked by

- #81 — [T32.13] Certify trusted in-process hostile-input limits
